en.name: Bratwurst, smoked and processed
en.summary: Smoked, processed bratwurst has been cured and fully cooked in the smokehouse, so it arrives ready to eat and simply needs heating through. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below it keeps 5–7 days, and it freezes for 2–3 months.
en.pantry: This is a refrigerated product, not a shelf-stable one. Smoking and cooking give it a longer fridge life than a fresh brat, but the water content is still high enough that it belongs in the cold. Out of the fridge it is bound by the two-hour rule — one hour above 32 °C (90 °F) — whether it is raw from the pack or reheated on a plate at a barbecue.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within 5–7 days. Leave an unopened vacuum pack sealed until you need it and go by the printed date if that falls sooner; once opened, re-wrap tightly or move the links to a sealed box. It is fully cooked, so it does not need to be kept below raw meat for safety reasons — but it is still worth storing it away from raw poultry and mince.
en.freezer: At −18 °C (0 °F) it keeps 2–3 months for best quality. Freeze the links individually wrapped and bagged so you can pull out one or two. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; past three months the smoke flavour fades and the fat starts to taste stale. Do not refreeze links that have been sitting out at a barbecue.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight, or heat straight from frozen in a pan or simmering water — it is already cooked, so you are only bringing it up to temperature.
spoilage: Slime on the casing, which is the classic first sign on a cooked sausage.
A sour or yeasty smell instead of a smoky one.
Any mould spots, or a grey-green sheen on the cut face.
A vacuum pack that has puffed up or is leaking.
tips: Note the opening date on the pack; the 5–7 days runs from purchase, not from the last time you looked.
Freeze what you will not eat in the first week, in single portions.
Reheat to steaming hot all the way through rather than just warming the outside.
Do not confuse it with the fresh version on the next shelf — the fresh one gets 2–3 days.

faq.q: How long does smoked bratwurst keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 5–7 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or the printed date if that comes first.

faq.q: Can you eat smoked bratwurst without cooking it?
faq.a: It is fully cooked and safe as sold, but it is much better heated through, and reheating is the safer habit for anyone vulnerable.
Yes, 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Wrap each link so you can take out just what you need.

zh.name: 煙燻熟製德國香腸
zh.summary: 煙燻加工的德國香腸在燻房裡已經醃過也全熟，買回來就是即食品，只要加熱到位即可。放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 5～7 天，冷凍 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 這是冷藏品，不是常溫品。煙燻和熟製讓它比生香腸耐放，但含水量仍然高，該待的地方還是冰箱。離開冰箱後一樣受 2 小時原則規範，室溫超過 32 °C 時縮為 1 小時——不管是剛拆封的，還是烤肉時已經加熱擺在盤子上的。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下，5～7 天內用完。未開封的真空包就讓它保持密封，若標示日期更早則以標示為準；開封後包緊或改放密封盒。它已經全熟，安全上不必刻意放在生肉下方，不過還是建議跟生禽肉、絞肉保持距離。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下品質可維持 2～3 個月。一條一條包好再裝袋，方便一次只拿一兩條。−18 °C 下安全性無限期，超過三個月煙燻香氣會淡掉、油脂開始出現陳味。烤肉時已經在室溫放過的香腸，不要再冰回冷凍庫。
zh.thawing: 冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接從冷凍下鍋煎、用滾水煮——它本來就是熟的，你只是把它加熱到溫度。
spoilage: 腸衣表面發黏，這是熟香腸最典型的第一個訊號。
聞起來發酸或有酵母味，而不是煙燻味。
出現霉點，或切面泛灰綠光澤。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日；5～7 天是從購買日算起，不是從你想起它那天算。
第一週內吃不完的部分分成單份冷凍。
復熱要熱到中心冒蒸氣，不能只把外皮弄熱。
不要跟旁邊的生香腸搞混——生的只有 2～3 天。

faq.q: 煙燻德國香腸冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下 5～7 天，若包裝日期更早則以包裝為準。

faq.q: 煙燻德國香腸可以不加熱直接吃嗎？
faq.a: 它是全熟品，出廠狀態即可食用，但加熱過更好吃；免疫力較弱的人建議一律加熱到全熱再吃。

faq.q: 煙燻德國香腸可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 2～3 個月。每條分開包，要吃多少拿多少。
